artworks.title: Landscape with Mountains, a River, and Elijah and the Raven
artworks.artist: Magdalena van de Passe, after Roelandt Savery and Adam Willaerts
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective above a rocky and wooded scene. The horizon is in the upper section of the composition, populated with intricate lines indicating distant mountains and a cloudy sky. Detailed and fine etching techniques are employed, with precise strokes creating textures in the trees and rocks. The color palette is monochromatic, varying from grey to white to black. The scene includes jagged rocks, trees with twisting branches, a waterfall cascading down rocks into a stream, and shadowy figures near the water. The composition is framed by bare trees and branches.

artworks.title: A Beach with Fishermen Cutting Up a Whale and the Prophet Elijah
artworks.artist: Magdalena van de Passe, after Roelandt Savery and Adam Willaerts
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a coastal scene with a large sailing ship in the foreground. A rocky cliff is on the right with a figure looking outward. The horizon is high, showing calm water, distant landforms, and ship masts reaching towards the sky. The etching features detailed lines to depict water, ship, and rock textures, creating depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black. Additional ships are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Seashore with HIgh Seas, a Ship, and the Prophet Elijah [God Helping the Israelites Fight the Moabites]
artworks.artist: Magdalena van de Passe, after Roelandt Savery and Adam Willaerts
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene from a slightly elevated point, displaying various elements from close to far. The horizon is visible where the sea meets the sky, without distinct land features. The composition uses detailed brushstrokes to depict texture and movement in the sea and sky. Light rays shine through dark clouds, illuminating the scene. A figure carrying a bundle walks towards a bridge, with some buildings, cliffs, and trees close by. In the distance, two ships battle rough waves amidst rain and clouds. The color scheme is mainly grayscale, emphasizing the scene's mood and detail.

artworks.title: Vienne, Saint Jean
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Scott Nathan and Laura DeBonis
artworks.description: The image shows a river flowing through a town, surrounded by buildings. The river reflects light, the town has aged buildings, a bridge, and hills in the background. The color palette is sepia tones, emphasizing textures and shapes in the scene.

artworks.title: Vienne, Souterrain
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a railway station with a straight view down the tracks. The tracks lead into a tunnel in the rocky hillside covered with vegetation. The platform is active with people walking or standing on both sides of the track. On the left, there is a large building with arched doorways opening onto the platform. To the right, a smaller building matches the larger structure. The hillside is rocky and covered with trees. The color palette is sepia with a light-colored sky.

artworks.title: Arles, Cloître Saint-Trophîme (Arles, Saint-Trophime Cloister)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a historic cloister. The image captures a long, narrow corridor with an arched stone ceiling and rows of intricately carved columns lining either side. The columns on the left are adorned with elaborate capitals and supporting a series of arches that open up to an inner courtyard. The corridor is cast in a soft, sepia tone, lending an antique quality to the scene. Light enters from the left, highlighting the textures of the stone floor and the carvings on the columns. The end of the corridor fades into shadow, adding depth to the photograph.

artworks.title: Palais des Nonnes, Chichen-Itza: Façade principale (Palace of the Nuns, Chichen-Itza: Main Facade)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: This image shows an ancient stone structure from a frontal low-angle viewpoint. The intricate carvings on the facade are visible, surrounded by dense foliage. Trees in the background create a sense of enclosure, with a sepia-toned color palette emphasizing the weathered textures of the stone. Soft lighting and a vintage quality are highlighted by the soft focus and fine grain of the photograph.

artworks.title: Date palms, Karnak
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Scott Nathan and Laura DeBonis
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of tall palm trees in the center. The horizon line is low, with faint hills and foliage visible in the background. The image is sepia-toned. The ground has small shrubs and grasses, leading to the tall palm trees with sprawling fronds. More palms and vegetation are visible in the distance, creating a natural composition with an earthy color scheme that emphasizes textures.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait of Giovanni Antonio Ranza
artworks.artist: Italian 18th Century, after Giovanni Antonio Ranza
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left. He has a serious expression, wide-set eyes, and long curly hair. He is wearing a dark coat with decorative buttons, a cravat, and a large hat with a feather and a brooch. He is holding a document in his right hand. There are books on a table, a decorative border with floral motifs, a circular frame with text, and a crest with a botanical design at the bottom center.

artworks.title: Battleground of Resaca, Georgia, No 3
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: Damaged branches of leafless trees twist against a blank sky in this horizonal black and white photograph. Blasted and fallen trunks lie in scrubby growth along the bottom third of the picture. A structure is visible on a far hill near the horizon, just right of center.

artworks.title: Mirror Lake, near the Wisconsin Dells
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: We look across a glassy lake at a V-shaped slice of cloudy sky between banks of trees that reach from the top corners of this horizontal black and white photograph to just below the center of the composition. The forest and sky are reflected in the water below, turning the V of sky into an X. A wooden dock extends into view from the lower right corner, and a few branches from a tree out of sight dip down across the right half of the top edge.

artworks.title: Rock Formation with Figure
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: A person sits in a rocky formation at the edge of a dense forest in this horizontal black and white photograph. The rocks are blocky and horizontally or diagonally striated. The person sitting inside has pale skin, a dark mustache, and wears a dark suit. A stretch of sand separates us from the structure.

artworks.title: Lower Jaws, Dells of the Wisconsin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: Two men in a canoe row toward us and a bank of rocks and boulders lining the bottom edge of this black and white, nearly square photograph. Sheer cliffs and trees rise from the banks to each side. The cliffs narrow like an almost closed letter C a short distance from us and then open onto wider tree-lined banks beyond. Puffy clouds skim across the sky above.

artworks.title: In Cold Water Canyon, Dells of the Wisconsin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: Two rocky, striated walls nearly fill this vertical black and white photograph. Through a narrow gap, like an open zipper, more striated rocks are visible.

artworks.title: At the Mouth of Cold Water Canyon, Dells of the Wisconsin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: From the flat top of striated, sheer rocks, we look down onto a person rowing a canoe toward us in a river in this horizontal black and white photograph. The rocky banks funnel the river, which comes toward us, like a canal. Evergreen trees are spiky silhouettes against a cloudy, pale sky. Printed text at the bottom left of the photograph reads, “At the Mouth of Cold Water Canyon, Dells of the Wisconsin. Copyright by Henry H. Bennett.”

artworks.title: Woman Sewing, Man Painting
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: A man sits painting at an easel set up under a tree and a woman sits nearby, her back to the trunk, sewing a white cloth in this horizontal black and white photograph. The tree reaches off the top edge of the composition to our right of center. The two people sit on the left half, angled in that direction so we see them almost in profile. The man wears a floppy cap and dark suit. He holds an oval paint palette in one hand and lifts a paintbrush to the painting with the other. The woman’s dark hair is gathered atop her head, and she looks down at her work. She wears a long-sleeved, ankle-length dress with a high collar. Bushes and mountains are hazy in the distance.

artworks.title: Loading Hay
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: Two men pitchfork hay onto a horse-drawn carriage in a field in this horizontal black and white photograph. The platform of the carriage is wider than the two white horses harnessed to it. One man tosses hay onto the top of the pile and the other man standing there. We look slightly down a hill, which is spanned a short distance away by a band of evergreen trees. Rolling hills are hazy in the distance beyond.

artworks.title: Country Store and Post Office
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: Six people sit or stand in the shade of a porch on a building off a dirt road in this horizontal black and white photograph. A saddled white horse stands next to a hitching post near a tree with a sprawling canopy to our right. A man smoking a pipe on the porch sits under a paper bulletin curling away from where it was posted on the wall behind him. Three children sit near some steps perhaps playing a game. An upside-down horseshoe hangs on the horizontal siding to our left. Wood boxes, a barrel, and other equipment are piled nearby.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.medium: stereoscopic albumen silver prints with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: Two black and white photographs with arched tops both show a masted ship with full sails. They are mounted on a bright orange background. In each photograph the ship is on the horizon, which comes about halfway up the composition. Four or five long rowboats are gathered on a dark field closer to us. What first looks like ripping water at closer inspection could be fabric and props. The rowers’ clothing is touched with red.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family, near Meadville, Pennsylvania
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered outside a two-story brick house. The group includes individuals of various ages, with different clothing styles typical of a past era. Some individuals are standing, while others are sitting or kneeling. Two children are being held, and some adults are holding objects like a cane or hat. The group is positioned on grass with a large flower arrangement in front, and the house has a symmetrical façade with large windows. The surroundings include well-maintained foliage, suggesting a formal setting or special occasion.

artworks.title: Granite Silver Mine, Montana
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with wooden industrial buildings spread across rocky terrain. The viewpoint is elevated, offering a broad view of the area. In the distance, there is a hillside with scattered trees and smoke rising from smokestacks. A dirt path winds through rocks towards red-brown buildings with white-trimmed windows. Further away, more buildings are visible on a slope with smoke rising from them. The color palette is sepia, giving the scene a vintage feel.

artworks.title: Cinnabar Mountain and Devil's Slide
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rocky terrain covered with scattered boulders in the foreground. A railway track runs diagonally across the rocky expanse. Beyond the tracks, the land transitions into a broad, flat valley leading to a mountain range. The mountains rise steeply in the distance with erosion patterns and sparse vegetation. The mountains form a natural horizon line against a clear sky. The color palette is dominated by muted tones of brown and gray, emphasizing the arid quality of the landscape. The detailed textures of the scene are captured in black and white.

artworks.title: Ruins of Cliff Dwellings, Canyon de Chelly
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a steep rock face dominating the composition, viewed from below. The horizon is not visible because the perspective focuses on the towering cliff. At the upper part of the image, there are ruins of ancient dwellings perched on a narrow ledge within the rocky cliff, partially sheltered by a deep recess in the rock. The rock surface texture is detailed with linear striations running diagonally. The color palette is monochromatic, with warm sepia tones. Plants and shrubbery are scattered at the base of the cliff, leading the eye upwards to the distant ruins.

artworks.title: Hunting Along the Mexican Border
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: Two men stand outdoors. One man on the left carries a deer over his shoulders, dressed in a patterned shirt, trousers, and boots. He holds a rifle and wears a hat. The man on the right points into the distance and holds a rifle, dressed in a suit and hat. The outdoor setting includes natural vegetation, rocks, and trees in the background.
